title: WeddingVendor
description: One vendor of a wedding (issue #33): who they are, where the contract stands, and what is owed when. Money is tracked, never moved: integer cents, no payment provider. The couple sees a vendor only when the planner shares it. Stored under groupedKey(wedding_id, vendor_id) and read one wedding at a time.

vendor_id.description: Identity within the owning tenant's partition, from the injected id generator.

tenant_id.description: The owning tenant. Compared to the context's tenant only; never selects the partition.

category.description: What they provide, from a fixed list; `other` with `category_other` naming it.

installments.description: The payment schedule, in order. At most 24 (enforced by the vendor service: a maxItems here would generate a tuple type).

installment_id.description: Stable across edits of the schedule.

amount_cents.description: The amount in integer cents (never a float).

deposit.description: Whether this installment is the deposit (at most one per vendor).

paid_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC time it was marked paid, while paid.

shared_with_couple.description: Whether the wedding's couple sees this vendor (the planner's call).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC creation time, from the injected clock.

updated_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC time of the last change, when changed.
